title: Decision Case Status
description: Governance workflow state owned and changed only by Governance Service: CREATED begins a case; PREFLIGHT_COMPLETED passed deterministic checks; EVALUATION_REQUESTED awaits evaluation; PROPOSAL_READY has a proposal; ASSURANCE_EVALUATED completed assurance; VERIFICATION_REQUIRED needs evidence; BLOCKED cannot proceed on this run; RECALCULATION_REQUIRED requires a new run; RESOLVED ends the governance path.
